claims: Scarpetta Season 2 is already in production.
Prime Video ordered two seasons of Scarpetta simultaneously upon announcing the show.
Scarpetta Season 2 is expected to release around mid- to late 2027.
Filming for Scarpetta Season 2 began early 2026.
Scarpetta Season 2 adapts Patricia Cornwell’s books Cruel and Unusual and The Body Farm.
Scarpetta Season 2 is expected to focus on elements from books 4 (Cruel and Unusual) and 5 (The Body Farm).
Scarpetta Season 2 will continue with a dual-timeline narrative.
Scarpetta Season 2 will pick up after the Season 1 cliffhanger.
Nicole Kidman returns as Kay Scarpetta in Scarpetta Season 2.
Jamie Lee Curtis returns as Dorothy in Scarpetta Season 2.
Bobby Cannavale returns as Pete Marino in Scarpetta Season 2.
Simon Baker returns as Benton Wesley in Scarpetta Season 2.
Ariana DeBose returns as Lucy in Scarpetta Season 2.
Liz Sarnoff confirmed that Patricia Cornwell is involved in the writers' room for Scarpetta Season 2.
